name: ai-sidecar-debug-fix
description: Systematic debug, build, test, and deploy of the ai-sidecar LangChain/LangGraph RAG microservice

changes.description: Add retriever timeout (5s), noop retriever for offline vector stores, VECTOR_STORE_PROVIDER=none support
Add timeout/maxRetries to model constructor args, add LLM_API_KEY to Google GenAI key chain
Add global Express error middleware to prevent unhandled errors from crashing the server
Add uncaughtException and unhandledRejection process handlers
5-level directory walker finds root .env for LLM_PROVIDER=gemini and API keys
8s timeout on retriever.invoke() to prevent TCP hang on ChromaDB localhost:8000
invokeWithTimeout wrapping model.invoke(), graceful fallback to mock answer on timeout/429
Capture answer from on_chain_end events so SSE works in non-streaming mode
Mock answer generation via generateMockAnswer(), mock follow-up questions
ENABLE_MOCK_MODE env var support for offline/demo mode
Replace static canvas import with lazy dynamic import to fix native module build error on Windows
Change sidebar default state from open to collapsed on /scan page

notes: Gemini free tier returns 429 (rate limited); ENABLE_MOCK_MODE=true provides demo responses
canvas@3.1.0 native binary not compiled on Windows; dynamic import prevents build failure
ChromaDB not running locally; retriever gracefully returns empty docs after 8s timeout
